name: Rational-orientation common-neighbour exceptional paired circles, complete first boundary
kernel: P={d+s: d in centres, s in U union r*U}, U=<omega>
support: Q=P union all intersections C(d,1) intersect C(x,1), d in centres, x in P minus centres
bound_proof: |P|<=48, four centres lie in P, and at most eight added incidences per noncentre kernel point: |Q|<=48+8*(48-4)=400
rationale: Exact exceptional placement with one point adjacent to all four centres defeats every distinct-centre-pin extension theorem. Full first boundary contains every unit contact from kernel to infinite support; direct ordinary complete-graph status is the sole chromatic gate.
preflight: Distinct centres; nonparallel unit pairs, not common midpoint; cross squared distances 4/5,(7+4*sqrt(3))/5,(7-4*sqrt(3))/5,4/5 are regular and neither sqrt3 nor >2 distances. No accepted full-support colouring identified for this placement.
solver: One Kissat4 query, 60 seconds/1000000 conflicts. If UNSAT check DRAT and seek proper5; SAT ends architecture.
